folds.heading: ## Historical-source and current-case reconciliation, B9, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Content-reviewed the eighteen S001 historical records and this full backlog, distinguishing fresh checkpoint reads from reuse of inspected prior full-content notes on unchanged inputs. The later remainder checkpoint records parent source/build adoption after leaf handbacks; it does not prove the five behavioral families here. Keep source presence, native publication, earned acquisition, ordinary-life use and persistent recovery separate (AD32/AD36/AD43).

Preserve the actual interactions: exact owned toolkit/part/rope custody and one return; funded independent workers and accepted-vs-offered actors; retained roster offers with no cancellation reroll; earned lessons and foregone options; stage support and once-only paid outcomes; actual reports that can change another actor's knowledge without retroactive entitlement. Definition counts, a parent bundle and a paid practice fixture are different evidence. The finite ALL19 source objective stays closed at its own scope; deeper ACS research and actual behavioral receiver gaps are separately selectable.

The old implementation-first sentence and old schema fixture list record the original phase, not a standing exemption from current AD43 or a universal migration requirement. This review neither runs those scenarios nor restarts source workers. When one case is selected, use its current owner/actual carrier/clock and the applicable current checks; AD42 keeps human taste feedback separate. [B9 input/disposition](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b9.json).

folds.heading: ## Five-family content reconciliation, B9, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full review of this backlog and current revision13 checkpoint preserves GD-01, Known Routes Here and ACS-P01–P03 as finite historical joins, with no fresh runtime/canon proof. Parent release supersedes old leaf leases/pending source integration; it does not close save, failure, natural-route or UI evidence. The original metadata-intake total is not a semantic source-reading count (AD32/AD36).

Keep the useful mechanisms distinct: paid negative assay/control comparison and actual useful kit; one real balm dose and completion-time effect decay; frozen refinement outcome and supported retry preparation; real funded work claim plus independent assent and attributed later account. A cancelled, naturally expired or unsupported treatment is not successful care; unseen NPC completion is not a player report. Original local numbers/limits are authored choices, not universal rules or new balance gates.

The opening global test deferral is historical. Current selected work follows AD36/AD43 and actual persistence/disclosure/failure consumers; human review under AD42 remains optional feedback. Exact old source/build identities and every unrun case remain here; this reconciliation activates none of them and authorizes no new worker, acquisition or release. [B9 ledger](../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/content-b9.json).
